SELECT a.id, a.number, a.job_name, a.app_id, b.name AS app_name, b.domain_id, c.name AS domain_name, a.job_class_name, a.mutex_key, a.cron_expression, a.status, a.description, a.is_system, a.version, a.create_time, a.update_time FROM t_sys_job a INNER JOIN t_sys_app b ON b.id = a.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain c ON c.id = b.domain_id
AND b.domain_id = #{form.domainId} AND a.app_id = #{form.appId} AND a.status = #{form.status}
AND (a.number LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%') OR a.job_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{form.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ${listQuery.sortColumn} ${listQuery.sortOrder}, a.id DESC ORDER BY a.create_time DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT DISTINCT c.id AS domain_id, c.name AS domain_name, b.id AS app_id, b.name AS app_name, c.seq AS domain_seq, b.seq AS app_seq FROM t_sys_job a INNER JOIN t_sys_app b ON b.id = a.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain c ON c.id = b.domain_id ORDER BY c.seq, c.id, b.seq, b.id

SELECT a.id AS job_id, a.job_name, a.app_id, b.name AS app_name, b.domain_id, c.name AS domain_name FROM t_sys_job a INNER JOIN t_sys_app b ON b.id = a.app_id INNER JOIN t_sys_domain c ON c.id = b.domain_id WHERE a.id = #{id}
